task: T4.4 SBDD Cascade — Pocket2Mol (5/5 targets) + TargetDiff (5/5 targets, corrected) + ADMET-AI
method: Pocket2Mol pretrained (co-crystal-ligand-centered, GPU-compat patched) + TargetDiff diffusion (GPU-compat + pocket-crop fixed) → r_L4 + r_L5 (PAINS/BRENK) + r_L6a (ADMET-AI) + r_L6b (0.6 pathogen-target); all scores on one canonical weight set.
notes: All 5 targets now covered by BOTH generative models — Pocket2Mol's 3 previously-stalled targets (Mpro/7VH8, HIV_RT/1VRT, NS3/2OC8) were unblocked in this session by (1) user-authorized checkpoint download from the official Pocket2Mol Google Drive link, and (2) the same GPU-compat patch class used for TargetDiff, extended to 5 more independently-bound torch_scatter/torch_geometric.nn import sites found by a full-repo grep, plus a real bug fix in the generic cpu_routed() helper (it only captured the source device from positional args, silently leaving kwargs-only calls' results stranded on CPU).
